subject.title: Proposal: model-callable `clear_goal` tool with bounded canonical-store archive

question: Should OpenClaw allow a model-callable `clear_goal` tool to clear terminal or paused session goals, and what retained cleared-goal history contract should that create?
rationale: Current source and docs intentionally keep clearing operator-controlled, while the proposal changes model authority and adds durable session history semantics that automation should not decide.

options.title: Preserve operator-only clearing
options.body: Keep the current contract and close or redirect future `clear_goal` implementation work toward a non-destructive model signal surfaced to the operator.

options.title: Approve a narrow model clear tool
options.body: Allow `clear_goal` only for maintainer-approved non-active states, with canonical-store history, explicit retention semantics, and full metadata/docs/proof coverage.

options.title: Approve terminal-only clearing now, defer archive history
options.body: Add a smaller model clear operation for `complete` and `blocked` goals while tracking retained history as a separate product decision.

recommendation.title: Preserve operator-only clearing
recommendation.body: Keep the current contract and close or redirect future `clear_goal` implementation work toward a non-destructive model signal surfaced to the operator.

likelyOwner.reason: This person introduced and recently maintained the core session-goal behavior and public contract that the proposal would change.
